content.text:
The evidence conflicts. Tenant 3 reports ammonia at 11.6, the highest of its set, with borax at 9.2. Tenant 4 reports that in a repeat test borax gave the highest reading, 12.1.

The rule says the greatest meter reading has the highest pH. Across all the readings provided, 12.1 (borax) is the greatest, above 11.6 (ammonia). Tenant 4's borax reading is a different measurement from Tenant 3's, and the evidence gives no reason to discard it. It is also a repeat test, which suggests it is the later measurement. Applying the rule to the greatest reading gives borax.

A
